member.name: T:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController
member.summary: Handles product-related operations including creation, retrieval, and management.
member.remarks: This controller provides endpoints for managing products in the inventory system. Different endpoints have different authorization requirements based on the operation.

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.CreateQuantifiedProductAsync(ElectroStock.Application.Dtos.CreateQuantifiedProductDto)
member.summary: Creates a new quantified product (e.g., accessories, cables, chargers).
member.param: The product creation details (SKU, brand, name, category, model, costs, initial quantity, minimum stock level)
member.returns: The newly created quantified product with all details

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.GetProductByIdAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Retrieves a product by its unique identifier.
member.remarks:
Gets detailed information about a specific product including its type (quantified or serialized) and current stock status. Users with Admin, Warehouse, or Cashier roles are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: GET /api/product/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6 Authorization: Bearer {token}
member.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the product to retrieve
member.returns: Detailed product information including type, stock, and pricing

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.GetProductBySkuAsync(System.String)
member.summary: Retrieves products by SKU (Stock Keeping Unit).
member.remarks:
Gets a list of products matching the provided SKU (exact match). Since SKU is typically unique, this usually returns a single product if quantified product, a list of products if serialized product. Users with Admin, Warehouse, or Cashier roles are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: GET /api/product/sku/CBL-USBC-001 Authorization: Bearer {token}
member.param: The unique SKU code of the product to retrieve
member.returns: List of products with the matching SKU

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.GetProductsByCategoryAsync(ElectroStock.Domain.Enums.ProductCategory)
member.summary: Retrieves all products in a specific category.
member.remarks:
Gets a list of all products belonging to the specified product category. Users with Admin, Warehouse, or Cashier roles are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: GET /api/product/category/Smartphone Authorization: Bearer {token}
member.param: The product category (e.g., Smartphone, Accessory, Tablet, Laptop)
member.returns: List of products in the specified category

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.GetAllProductsAsync
member.summary: Retrieves all products in the inventory system.
member.remarks:
Gets a complete list of all products regardless of category or type. Users with Admin, Warehouse, or Cashier roles are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: GET /api/product Authorization: Bearer {token}
member.returns: List of all products in the system

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.ChangeProductPriceAsync(System.String,System.Decimal)
member.summary: Updates the selling price for all products with the specified SKU.
member.remarks:
Changes the unit price (selling price) for all products matching the provided SKU. This affects future sales only. Historical invoice data remains unchanged. Only users with Admin role are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: POST /api/product/CBL-USBC-001/price?price=24.99 Authorization: Bearer {admin-token}
member.param: The SKU of the product(s) to update
The new selling price (must be greater than or equal to unit cost)
member.returns: Success message confirming the price update

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.ChangeProductCostAsync(System.String,System.Decimal)
member.summary: Updates the cost price for all products with the specified SKU.
member.remarks:
Changes the unit cost (purchase price) for all products matching the provided SKU. Only users with Admin role are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: POST /api/product/CBL-USBC-001/cost?cost=9.50 Authorization: Bearer {admin-token}
member.param: The SKU of the product(s) to update
The new cost price (must be greater than zero)
member.returns: Success message confirming the cost update

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.DiscontinueProductAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Discontinues a product.
member.remarks:
Marks a product as discontinued, making it unavailable for sale nor reservation. Discontinued products remain in the system for historical purposes but cannot be added to new invoices. Only users with Admin role are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: POST /api/product/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/discontinue Authorization: Bearer {admin-token}
member.param: The unique identifier of the product to discontinue
member.returns: Success message confirming the product was discontinued

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ProductController.PublishProductAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Publishes a product, making it available for sale.
member.remarks:
Publishes a previously unpublished or discontinued product, making it available for sale. Only users with Admin role are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: POST /api/product/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/publish Authorization: Bearer {admin-token}
member.param: The unique identifier of the product to publish
member.returns: Success message confirming the product was published

member.summary: Confirms a reservation and converts it to an invoice.

Confirms a pending reservation, converting it to a confirmed invoice. Stock is permanently deducted from inventory and the customer is charged. Cashiers and Admins are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: PATCH /api/reservation/RES-20250724-0001?method=Cash Authorization: Bearer {token}
member.param: The reservation number to confirm
The payment method (Cash, DebitCard)
member.returns: The confirmed invoice details

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.ReservationController.CancelReservationAsync(System.String)
member.summary: Cancels a pending reservation.
member.remarks:
Cancels a pending reservation, releasing all reserved stock back to inventory. Only pending reservations can be cancelled. Cashiers and Admins are authorized to perform this action.

member.name: T:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.StockController
member.summary: Handles stock-related operations including receiving, tracking, and inventory management.
member.remarks: This controller provides endpoints for warehouse staff and administrators to manage inventory. All endpoints require authentication with Warehouse or Admin role.

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.StockController.ReceiveSerializedProductAsync(System.String,ElectroStock.Application.Dtos.CreateSerializedProductDto)

The product details including serial numbers

member.summary: Receives stock for an existing quantified product.
member.remarks:
For quantified products (e.g., accessories, cables), adds bulk quantity to existing stock. The product must already exist in the system (created via Admin). Only users with Warehouse or Admin roles are authorized to perform this action.

member.param: The SKU of the product to receive stock for
The quantity to add to inventory (must be greater than zero)
member.returns: Updated stock information including new quantity

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.StockController.GetCurrentStockAsync(System.String)
member.summary: Retrieves current stock information for a product by SKU.
member.remarks:
Gets the current stock status including quantity on hand, reserved, and available. Users with Warehouse or Admin roles are authorized to perform this action.
Sample request: GET /api/stock/CBL-USBC-001/stock Authorization: Bearer {token}
member.param: The SKU of the product to check
member.returns: Current stock information including: - Sku: Product identifier - QuantityOnHand: Total physical stock - QuantityReserved: Stock reserved for pending orders - QuantityAvailable: Stock available for sale (OnHand - Reserved)

member.name: M:ElectroStock.API.Controllers.StockController.GetStockMovementsHistoryAsync(System.Guid)

member.param: The unique identifier of the product
member.returns: List of all stock movements for the product
